d.ko:
"I can't sleep."

A cute and possibly just a little bit scary puzzle platformer game.
Move stickers to the right positions in order to get rid of the monsters and complete the sticker book.

“睡不着觉。”

 一个小小的微恐怖横版解谜游戏。
在绘本一般的幻想世界里，拖动贴纸到合适的位置解密，战胜对怪物的恐惧吧。
